title: Red Sign of Shudde M'ell

'''Red Sign of Shudde M'ell''' is a [[spell]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Casting Modifier''': -1

'''Sanity Cost''': 1

'''Any Phase''': Cast and exhaust to lower a [[monster]]'s [[toughness]] by 1 (to a minimum of 1) and ignore one of its special abilities other than [[Magical Immunity]] until the end of this combat.

'''Hands''': 1

== Clarification ==
Only special abilities marked in bold can be chosen to be ignored, i.e. not special combat abilities like the [[Nightgaunt]] has.
